# MenuQR

> MenuQR is a QR menu and table-ordering platform for restaurants, cafes, and food outlets in Pakistan. Customers scan a QR code, browse the digital menu, order from their table, and request the bill — no app download needed.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and how it works.
